title: React Native Developer
description:
Job Summary Job Title: React Native Developer About the Role: We are seeking a motivated React Native Developer to join our IT team in Mohali. You will build and maintain high-quality cross-platform mobile applications for Android and iOS that deliver intuitive user experiences and integrate reliably with backend services. This role has direct impact on product delivery and customer experience, requires close collaboration with product owners, designers, QA and backend engineers, and offers opportunities to influence mobile architecture and best practices. Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native for Android and iOS. Implement responsive, accessible and performant mobile UIs in collaboration with UX/UI designers. Integrate mobile apps with backend services via RESTful APIs and GraphQL, handling offline scenarios and synchronization. Build and maintain native bridges and modules when platform-specific functionality is required. Diagnose and resolve performance, memory, and stability issues across platforms. Participate in code reviews, enforce coding standards and improve the team's development processes. Deliver CI/CD pipelines and automation for builds, testing and app store releases. Write and maintain unit, integration and end-to-end tests to ensure product quality. Contribute to mobile architecture decisions, technical design, and documentation. Technology Stack Core: React Native, JavaScript, TypeScript State management: Redux, Context API, MobX (optional) Networking: REST APIs, GraphQL, Axios/Fetch Native platforms tools: Android Studio, Xcode, native modules (Java/Kotlin, Objective-C/Swift) Storage caching: AsyncStorage, SQLite, Realm, secure storage / Keychain CI/CD release: Git, GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins/CircleCI, Fastlane, App Center Testing: Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, Appium (optional) Observability services: Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics), Sentry, Push Notifications (FCM/APNs) Backend cloud: Node.js integrations, REST/GraphQL servers, familiarity with AWS / Azure services (API Gateway, Lambda functions, S3) a plus Security auth: OAuth/JWT, secure coding practices Requirements Minimum 2-5 years of professional experience developing mobile applications with React Native. Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, modern React patterns and hooks. Proven experience integrating mobile apps with backend services (REST/GraphQL) and handling offline-first scenarios. Hands-on experience with platform-specific debugging and building native modules when needed. Familiarity with mobile app lifecycle, performance optimization, memory management and battery usage considerations. Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD automation and app store submission processes. Practical knowledge of unit and end-to-end testing for mobile applications. Understanding of authentication and secure data storage (OAuth/JWT, Keychain/Encrypted storage). Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and effective communication in cross-functional teams. Leadership Expectations Participate actively in sprint planning, technical estimation and delivery commitments. Conduct and participate in code reviews; promote clean, maintainable and testable code. Mentor junior developers and share best practices for mobile development. Provide technical input for architecture decisions and contribute to roadmap discussions. Communicate progress and technical risks to stakeholders clearly and proactively. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent (B.Tech Computer Science preferred). 2 to 5 years of relevant mobile development experience with production-grade React Native applications. Experience publishing apps to Google Play Store and Apple App Store is preferred. Demonstrable portfolio or code samples of mobile apps, with explanations of technical contributions and challenges solved. Location Location: Mohali, Punjab Employment Type: Full-Time, on-site (Mohali)

title: Front End Developer (SvelteKit, TypeScript)
description:
Front End Developer (SvelteKit, TypeScript) Location : On-Site 
 Job Type : Full-Time 
 Experience : No prior experience required, but personal projects, internships, or open-source contributions will be a plus. Tech Inject is a cutting-edge IT solutions provider specializing in Web Apps, hybrid mobile applications (Flutter, React Native), ERP, and E-commerce solutions. With over a decade of experience and 50+ successful projects, we engineer high-performance, visually appealing products across various industries, including travel, healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, and F&B. 
At Tech Inject, #WeEngineerImagination . Our work environment includes: Work-from-home flexibility Structured training programs Growth opportunities Responsibilities 
 What You Will Start With: Developing scalable and visually appealing user interfaces using SvelteKit, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with guidance. Collaborating with UI/UX designers and product teams to understand wireframes and implement pixel-perfect designs. Learning to implement responsive layouts, animations (GSAP, Lottie, PushIn.js), and UI performance optimizations. Ensuring cross-browser compatibility, SEO optimization, and accessibility (WCAG compliance) under mentorship. Working with SvelteKits SSR, CSR, and SSG concepts for rendering strategies. Fetching and handling API data using RESTful APIs, with gradual exposure to GraphQL APIs. Debugging UI issues and improving front-end performance based on feedback. Using Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development. Writing basic unit tests for front-end components to ensure stability. Understanding state management with Svelte stores for handling UI interactions. What Will Be Expected After Training: Independently building high-performance and scalable web applications with SvelteKit and TypeScript. Optimizing front-end rendering strategies using SSR, CSR, and SSG in SvelteKit. Designing and implementing complex UI interactions with state management techniques. Ensuring cross-browser compatibility, accessibility (WCAG compliance), and SEO best practices. Integrating APIs using REST and GraphQL. Writing and maintaining unit and integration tests to ensure reliability. Debugging UI issues independently and implementing performance optimizations. Engaging in code reviews, discussions on front-end architecture, and best practices. Requirements 
 What You Should Already Know: Basic proficiency in JavaScript & TypeScript Understanding of HTML, CSS, and modern CSS frameworks (Tailwind, SCSS, PostCSS) Familiarity with responsive design principles Basic knowledge of web performance optimization and accessibility concepts Understanding of Git and version control Problem-solving mindset and eagerness to learn What You Will Learn on the Job: Advanced SvelteKit and TypeScript best practices Frontend performance optimization techniques SSR, CSR, and SSG implementations in SvelteKit Integration of REST and GraphQL APIs Web accessibility (WCAG compliance) and SEO optimization State management using Svelte stores UI animations using GSAP, Lottie, and PushIn.js Unit testing and CI/CD for front-end applications Component-driven development and microfrontend architectures What We Offer: Structured training & mentorship Hands-on experience in production-level projects Career growth opportunities in front-end development Competitive salary Flexible working hours Schedule: Day shift, fixed schedule Location Type: In-person (Phagwara | Chandigarh, Punjab) relocation or reliable commute required.

Key Skills: css,javascript,html,typescript,sass,rest,frontend development,github
